watches.name: Permian Rift - Azurite
watches.description: Inspired by the shifting geology of deep time, the Permian Rift pairs a slim micro-rotor movement with a clean, architectural case that leans dressy without feeling delicate. Each dial is cut from natural stone, with unique grain and depth that makes every watch a true one-off. Applied indices and polished hands are carefully proportioned for clarity against the textured surface. Fitted on a tapering vegetable-tanned Italian leather strap with a signed clasp.

specsRaw.Hands: Polished leaf-shaped hour and minute hands.
specsRaw.Frequency: This calibre operates at 28,800 vibrations per hour (4Hz)
specsRaw.Functionality: Hand-winding and automatic-winding

watches.name: Bicompax - Atlantic Salmon
watches.description: The Bicompax is built as a daily driver chronograph - compact, versatile, and easy to wear with anything. A snug, wrist-hugging case with curved lugs keeps it comfortable, while the grained dial adds depth and a subtle, nostalgic “film grain” character. Highly polished indices and hands keep legibility sharp, and the balanced two-register layout keeps everything focused and functional. Fitted with a Stainless Steel Flat Link Bracelet with On-The-Fly Micro Adjustment. Each unit is individually numbered on the caseback.

specsRaw.Sapphire glass: Scratch resistant double-domed box sapphire crystal with underside anti-reflective coating for improved legibility.
specsRaw.Super-LumiNova: Super-LumiNova applied to the index and hands for low-light readability.
specsRaw.Caliber: Swiss Made Sellita SW510M BH b
specsRaw.Frequency: This caliber operates at 28,800 vibrations per hour (4Hz)
specsRaw.Functionality: Hacking functionality for precise time setting, chronograph start/stop function, 30 minute counter on right sub-dial.

watches.name: Seatrekker MKII - Blue
watches.description: Inspired by the super-compressor watches of the 1970s, the Seatrekker pays homage to this era with a dual crown case that operates an internal bezel. Decorated with highly polished indices and finished with a gorgeous sunburst effect, the Seatrekker makes a statement as an elegant yet robust diver. Fitted with a steel Flat Link Bracelet with On-The-Fly Micro Adjustment.

watches.name: Pulsatimer - Jet Black DLC
watches.description: The Pulsatimer’s aesthetic bridges the gap between rugged industrialism and refined elegance. With a keen eye for detail, we have crafted the Pulsatimer with a medley of finishes—brushed, polished, and sandblasted surfaces that juxtapose against each other, creating a layered and complex look reminiscent of Brutalist structures. Fitted with a TPU Tropic Rubber. Each unit is individually numbered on the caseback.

watches.name: Fiordland GMT - Martini Grey
watches.description: The Fiordland GMT is our rendition of a dual-time watch that fits between a dressy and an outright tool watch. With a heavy focus on finishing and textures, the Fiordland GMT prioritises visual depth via layering the dial with multiple forms of finishing. Complemented by a finely brushed case and polished chamfered lug edges. Fitted with a full-grain Italian leather strap and a stainless steel beads-of-rice bracelet.
